# Zero Block Feature

A versatile showcase section to map out core products, services, or technical highlights.

## Properties

- **Section Title (`title`)**: Overall section header.
- **Section Subtitle (`lead`)**: Accompanying introductory paragraph.
- **Features List (`featuresJson`)**: JSON array string of highlights: `[{"icon": "🚀", "title": "Scalable", "desc": "Grows with your needs"}, ...]`.
- **Layout Display (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: 3-Column Card Grid (Side-by-side)
  - `layout-2`: Split Image-Left (Visual graphic left, items stacked right)
  - `layout-3`: 4-Column Specifications Bullet List (Flat table layout)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark` / `transparent`
